name: Concept2
description: The dominant indoor-rowing brand - RowErg, SkiErg and BikeErg ergs plus racing oars, sold direct online since 1976. Its US affiliate program runs on Awin and pays a published 5% commission on referrals to its online shop; the machines are big-ticket staples of home-gym, CrossFit and Hyrox training content. No earnings-cap statement is published, so the cap stays unknown, and no creator counts are published, so saturation stays unknown.

evidence.summary: Concept2's Awin merchant profile (US program) states: 'Referrals to our online shop via our affiliate program will currently pay 5% commission.' The 5% base rate is recorded. No earnings-cap statement appears on the profile, so commission_cap is recorded as unknown.

The same Awin profile confirms an open affiliate program for the brand's direct online shop covering RowErgs, SkiErg, BikeErg, oars and accessories. No creator counts are published, so creator_saturation stays unknown.

reasons.niche_fit: The RowErg is the default rowing machine in home-gym tours, Hyrox prep and CrossFit content - erg scores and split times are inherently filmable, comparable content.
reasons.ugc_evidence: Open Awin program for a brand whose machines anchor a huge volume of training content; no dedicated creator page was verified beyond the network profile.
reasons.compensation: 5% on machines that sell for around $1,000 means roughly $50 per sale; rate verified on the network profile itself.
reasons.contact_access: Join route is via the Awin profile; no public affiliate email was verified.
reasons.opportunity_availability: Open Awin program; standard network approval applies.
reasons.credibility: Category-defining brand founded in 1976; rate verified on Awin itself.
